rows.text: 油量不足可能使齿轮和轴承润滑不充分并产生噪声。这只是可能原因之一，不能据此确定故障。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Troubleshooting: low lubricant and worn gears or bearings are possible causes of transmission noise.

rows.text: 轴承磨损或损坏可能在变速箱运转时产生噪声；其他故障也可能造成噪声。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Troubleshooting: low lubricant and worn gears or bearings are possible causes of transmission noise.

rows.text: 有些重型车辆的变速箱有很多挡位，例如有12挡变速箱。
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/ind/campaigns/traxon_campaign_page_2024.html — TraXon is a 12-speed automated transmission for heavy vehicles.

rows.text: 某些自动变速箱在换挡过程中保持扭矩传递，使车辆行驶更加平稳。
evidence: https://www.allisontransmission.com/innovation-and-technology/allison-advantage/automatics-vs-amts — Automatic transmission uses a planetary gear set and permits continuous power shifts.

rows.text: 油液润滑变速箱部件。应按该变速箱及其使用条件规定的周期更换。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-service-manual-trsm-0580-en-us.pdf — Preventive Maintenance, Transmission Oil: check the level and replace oil on the recommended schedule.

rows.text: 应按制造商的规定定期检查变速箱油位，以保持充分润滑。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-service-manual-trsm-0580-en-us.pdf — Preventive Maintenance, Transmission Oil: check the level and replace oil on the recommended schedule.

rows.text: 行星齿轮组是一组齿轮；某些变速箱用它获得不同的传动比范围。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/in/en-us/catalog/transmissions/9-speed-synchronized-medium-duty-manual-transmission.html — The range section provides high or low range through an epicyclic reduction gear.

rows.text: 相互啮合的齿轮转速与齿数成反比：被带动的小齿轮转得更快。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Gear ratios, p. 4: driven-to-driving tooth count determines the ratio; the table shows changing ratios.

rows.text: 被带动的大齿轮齿数较多，转速低于带动它的小齿轮：该传动比降低转速。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Gear ratios, p. 4: driven-to-driving tooth count determines the ratio; the table shows changing ratios.

rows.text: 齿数相同的两个啮合齿轮转速大小相等：传动比为一。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Gear ratios, p. 4: driven-to-driving tooth count determines the ratio; the table shows changing ratios.

rows.text: 辅助缓速器可以安装在变速箱输出侧，作用于传动系统以降低车速。
evidence: https://www.voith.com/corp-en/news-room/press-releases/2021-11-10-vt-voith-to-supply-retarders-for-turkish-truck-manufacturer.html — VR 115 CT is fitted on the transmission output side and provides braking.

rows.text: 变速器改变转速与扭矩的传动比，但变速器与车轮之间还有独立的主减速机构。超速挡可使变速器输出轴比发动机转得快，却不能证明车轮也如此。
evidence: Official superiori 29618 FALSO. Eaton https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf gives overdrive ratios; https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-trdr-0580-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf describes separate rear-axle gearing. Gearbox output speed is not wheel speed.

rows.text: 重型车辆变速箱通常不只限于两个挡位：有多挡配置，例如十二挡。
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/ind/campaigns/traxon_campaign_page_2024.html — TraXon is a 12-speed automated transmission for heavy vehicles.

rows.text: 发动机扭矩相同时，低挡对车轮扭矩的放大更大；高挡则较小。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Gear ratios, p. 4: driven-to-driving tooth count determines the ratio; the table shows changing ratios.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Shifting to lower gears: reduced crawler gearing helps start a heavy truck on steep inclines; greater driveline torque aids startability.

rows.text: 低挡对扭矩的放大更大，因此发动机扭矩相同时，车轮获得的牵引力更大。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — Gear ratios, p. 4: driven-to-driving tooth count determines the ratio; the table shows changing ratios.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Shifting to lower gears: reduced crawler gearing helps start a heavy truck on steep inclines; greater driveline torque aids startability.

rows.text: 重载车辆上坡时可能需要低挡来获得更大的牵引力；挡位取决于实际情况，并非总用最高挡。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-transmission-trdr-0011lr-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — General Information: low starting ratio and 18 forward speeds, with range and splitter sections.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Shifting to lower gears: reduced crawler gearing helps start a heavy truck on steep inclines; greater driveline torque aids startability.

rows.text: 满载车辆在坡道起步时，应选择足够低的挡位，以放大起步所需的扭矩。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-trsm-0226-medium-heavy-transmission-service-manual-en-us.pdf — Operation: use first gear to start, normal double clutching and downshifting to slow through engine compression.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Shifting to lower gears: reduced crawler gearing helps start a heavy truck on steep inclines; greater driveline torque aids startability.

rows.text: 安静的变速箱仍可使用齿轮：同步器有助于挂挡，但不会取代形成传动比的齿轮。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-proper-shifting-transmission-manual-driver-instructions-trdr0074-en-us.pdf — Introduction: synchronizers equalize rotating gear and shaft speeds before engagement.

rows.text: 挡位没有五挡的统一上限：重型车辆的自动变速箱可以有十二个挡位。
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/ind/campaigns/traxon_campaign_page_2024.html — TraXon is a 12-speed automated transmission for heavy vehicles.

rows.text: 同步手动变速箱应按制造商说明使用离合器；省略离合器操作不是节油规则。某些自动化变速箱采用不同的操作方式。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-proper-shifting-transmission-manual-driver-instructions-trdr0074-en-us.pdf — Clutch Operation: follow proper clutch procedure on synchronized manual transmissions.

https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf — General Clutch Information: manual changes use the clutch to interrupt torque; automated transmissions may use electronic control.

rows.text: 车速相同时，降挡会使发动机转得更快，而不是更慢。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-trdr-0580-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — Vehicle Speed vs Engine Speed & Gear, p. 13, and operation p. 16: higher shifts require lower engine rpm at the same road speed; tachometer assists shifting.

rows.text: 车速相同时，升挡会降低发动机转速，而不是提高转速。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-trdr-0580-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — Vehicle Speed vs Engine Speed & Gear, p. 13, and operation p. 16: higher shifts require lower engine rpm at the same road speed; tachometer assists shifting.

rows.text: 要增强发动机制动，应使用与车速相适应的较低挡位，而不是高挡。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-transmission-trdr-0060b-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — Driver Tips: Low mode maximizes engine braking on a long grade.

rows.text: 转速表显示发动机转速；它不直接显示驱动轮转速。
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-trdr-0580-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — Vehicle Speed vs Engine Speed & Gear, p. 13, and operation p. 16: higher shifts require lower engine rpm at the same road speed; tachometer assists shifting.

rows.text: 涡轮增压器由发动机排气驱动，其工作并非只有在三挡以上才开始。
evidence: https://www.garrettmotion.com/turbo-replacement/turbo-diagnosis/knowledge-base/ — How does a turbocharger work: exhaust gas drives the turbine coupled to the compressor.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata è FALSO, ma la frase afferma una possibilità senza specificare rapporti del cambio o della trasmissione finale. Un rapporto overdrive può rendere l’albero di uscita del cambio più veloce dell’ingresso; la velocità delle ruote dipende anche dal rapporto successivo. Non è verificata una ragione generale per escludere la possibilità riferita alle ruote, né il significato preciso inteso dal quesito.
checked_sources: Eaton TRSM-2105, p. 4, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-light-duty-synchromesh-transmissions-service-manual-trsm2105-en-us.pdf — elenca rapporti di quinta inferiori a 1 e definisce il rapporto mediante i denti degli ingranaggi.

Eaton RWRG0075, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/support/warranty-returns/eaton-commercial-vehicle-warranty/warranty-information/guidelines/rwrg0075.html — distingue velocità degli alberi di ingresso e uscita e rapporto complessivo del cambio.

Eaton TRDR-0580, p. 13, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-trdr-0580-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf — presenta un esempio con rapporto del ponte posteriore separato dal cambio; non stabilisce una limitazione universale della velocità delle ruote.
